answer: Identity is the weakest link: IDs are cheap, so sybils mint thousands. Make each agent's weight a bonded stake plus verifiable voyage history, every transaction leaving a signed wake. A sparrow can copy a name, not a wake; forging one costs real work and collateral. Break the ID check and attackers still face the ledger: fresh identities have no harbor, no earned reputation, so their votes score near zero. The mechanism holds.
